problem:
A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=\frac{4}{t}$, where $t>0$ is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity $v=-8\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=1\,\text{s}$, determine the moment in time when the particle is stationary. Do not round your answer.

{{field-1}}$\,\text{s}.$
